Welcome to Miami-Dade Transit's (MDT) proprietary mobile app - the only official transit mobile app from Miami-Dade County. With this application, you'll have accurate, real-time information on transit services in the Greater Miami area.

With this application, you will have access to:

Real-Time Bus, Train and Mover Tracker: Don't miss your next bus, train or mover car. See the estimated arrival time of buses, trains, and mover cars approaching your stop/station. Store your favorite stops and stations as favorites.

You can view the location of your bus, train or mover car on a map, so you can visually track it as it approaches your stop/station. Live tracking is now available for all bus routes.

Trip Planner: Conveniently plan your trip using public transportation from your current location to wherever you need to go.

Nearby: View all nearby stops and stations, real-time vehicles and route alignments. Scroll around the Miami-Dade County map and explore.

Mobile Barcode/Passes: Purchase a 1-Day or 7-Day mobile pass.

Transit Store: Manage existing EASY Cards, license plates for monthly parking and much more.

Fares: See an easy to use list of transit fares.

Rider Alerts Registration: Register here to get alerts from MDT whenever there are service updates, delays, disruptions or detours. Alerts are sent straight to your mobile device.

Current Service Updates: Instantly see which bus routes are being detoured, or if Miami-Dade Transit is operating under a different schedule during a special event or holiday.

Elevators/Escalators Status: See which elevators or escalators are out service at Metrorail or Metromover stations so you can plan ahead.

Special Transportation Services (STS): Book trips and get real-time estimated arrivals for your trips.

Transit Watch: Quick and easy reporting of safety and security issues.

Feedback Zone: MDT welcomes feedback from its customers. Use this app to submit your complaints, concerns, comments and suggestions or if you would like to report a safety issue.
